property_summary: For all callers, only the owner can successfully call withdrawAll(address) (non-owners' calls revert); the mutant flips the require and allows non-owners to succeed, so there exists a caller (non-owner) for which the mutant permits withdrawal while the reference reverts.
change_summary: Require that the caller is NOT the owner (negate the ownership check), allowing only non-owners to withdraw and changing observable behavior.
